newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy lower, corn, wheat steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy lower, corn, wheat steady.

text.p: FOB soybean basis values were slightly lower on Wednesday as farmer selling picked up while corn and wheat values were unchanged, export sources said.
"I think there's just been a little bit more cash movement with the board up today," one broker said.
But while soybean supplies were building in the pipeline, the broker said very little was being shipped.
Wheat values were flat despite talk of improved export demand along with rumors the EU might cut export subsidies.
There was talk Egypt would be in the market by the weekend for 250,000 to 300,000 tonnes of wheat.

There were also persistent rumors that Turkey was looking to buy wheat but a USDA official on Wednesday said there would be no export certificates issued until a trade dispute was resolved. Turkey reportedly tightened its phytosanitary requirements to levels considered unacceptable by USDA.
